name: SecureCRT Importer
description: 通过 Rust WASM 自动扫描 SecureCRT 默认配置目录，导入 SSH 会话并将 Sessions 连接分组转换为 Navop 工作区，同时导入 Button Bar / Command Manager 快捷命令及其分组；如果扫描不到或结果不正确，请优先选择 SecureCRT 的 Config 配置根目录，也支持选择单个 XML/INI 配置文件。 Automatically scans SecureCRT's default configuration directories through Rust WASM, imports SSH sessions, converts Sessions connection groups into Navop workspaces, and imports Button Bar / Command Manager quick commands with their groups; if nothing is found or the result is incorrect, choose the SecureCRT Config root directory first, or select individual XML/INI configuration files.
